notes:
Read-along now has a sense of pacing.

It used to pause for almost the same length of time whatever had just happened — and, oddly, it paused LONGER between two speech bubbles on the same page than it did when turning to a new page or starting a new chapter. Nothing in the audio ever told you a page had ended.

The pauses now form a proper ladder: a short beat between bubbles in the same panel, a longer one across panels, longer again when narration hands over to dialogue, and real breathing room at a page turn, a new chapter, and after a chapter is announced by name.

They still scale with your reading speed, so asking to be read to faster shortens the pauses too.
